collection: Fondo Vaticano Arabo & Fondo Vaticano Latino

manuscripts.author: Ebû Caʿfer Ahmed bin Muhammed el-Gāfikī
manuscripts.illustration_description: Descriptive botanical annotations with Greek and Latin binomial cross-references.
manuscripts.subject: Pharmacology & Botany
manuscripts.latin_translation: Quoted and abstracted by Barhebraeus and translated into Hebrew
manuscripts.historical_importance: The primary foundation for Ibn al-Baytar's pharmacopoeia; introduced rigorous botanical precision in plant morphology and habitats.
references: Meyerhof, M. & Sobhy, G. P., The Abridged Version of the Book of Simple Drugs of Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Ghafiqi, Cairo, 1932

manuscripts.title_turkish: Toledo Tercüme Mektebi Gerard of Cremona Külliyatı
manuscripts.author: Gerard of Cremona (Mütercim)
manuscripts.illustration_description: Astronomical tables, geometric proofs from Jabir ibn Aflah and al-Zarqali.
manuscripts.subject: Transmission of Science
manuscripts.latin_translation: Primary compilation containing Latin translations of 12 Andalusian and Baghdadi scientific classics
manuscripts.historical_importance: The quintessential manuscript witness documenting the systematic transfer of Arabic sciences to Western Christendom in 12th century Toledo.
references: Burnett, C., The Coherence of the Arabic-Latin Translation Programme in Toledo in the Twelfth Century, 2001

manuscripts.title_arabic: الشروح الكبرى لابن رشد على أرسطو
manuscripts.title_turkish: İbn Rüşd'ün Aristoteles Büyük Şerhleri Latin Nüshası
manuscripts.author: Averroes (translated by Michael Scot and William of Luna)
manuscripts.illustration_description: Extensive marginal glosses from Latin Averroists of Bologna and Padua.
manuscripts.subject: Metaphysics & Natural Philosophy
manuscripts.latin_translation: In libros De Anima, Metaphysica, Physica Aristotelis
manuscripts.historical_importance: Formed the intellectual battlefield of 13th-century scholasticism; used directly by Thomas Aquinas in Summa Theologiae and De unitate intellectus contra Averroistas.
references: Wolfson, H. A., Crescas' Critique of Aristotle, Harvard, 1929
